postfixSecurityProfile: default Docker seccomp, no-new-privileges, exact capabilities, readonly root, root-owned 0400 TLS mounts
limits: Production registry pin, Kubernetes/Cilium acceptance, queue accounting and backup restore remain rollout gates.
External null-envelope DSNs remain unsupported by Resend; this was deferred in the prior cutover.
Positive cache expiry is one hour plus any remaining native 1000-second pending-probe grace; negative refresh does not revoke an unexpired positive.
Exact native recipient verification requires disabling domain-wide automatic sub-addressing; explicit plus aliases remain accepted.
Stock mail-auth returns DMARC none if no mechanism passes; no custom authentication-score overrides are installed.
Local generated and wrong-CA cases include direct-adapter controls; Postfix-generated local DSN and actual Postfix queue restart are tested separately.
